title: K-beauty giant APR's shares up 100% this year ahead of U.S. Costco launch in September
summary: South Korean beauty company APR has seen its shares surge approximately 100% in 2026 as it accelerates U.S. market expansion with a Costco launch scheduled for September. The milestone reflects rising consumer demand for K-beauty products in North America.
content: APR is accelerating its U.S. retail expansion with a Costco launch in September, as the K-beauty company's shares have surged nearly 100% this year.

zh.title: K美巨头APR股价今年上涨100%，美国好市多9月推出在即

title: Singapore tackles finances and culture to avert a demographic crisis
summary: Singapore is implementing financial and cultural policy reforms to address its demographic crisis, though measurable results from these efforts may take considerable time to emerge. The initiative reflects broader challenges facing developed Asian economies regarding aging populations and birth rates.
content: One challenge for policy makers is that success on many measures won't show up immediately.

title: What caused Nvidia's nasty reversal Friday? Look to the Fed for clues

content: In his Sunday column for Investing Club subscribers, Jim Cramer explores the linkage between Nvidia's stock, the oil market, and the Federal Reserve.

title: 'My parents won't lend me £10k but helped my brother': When families play financial favourites

title: I'm a psychologist who studies couples: The happiest couples never fight about this 1 thing (it's not sex or money)
